title: G-Mixup: Graph Data Augmentation for Graph Classification
issue_source: ReScience C [¬Re] report by Cordaro, Cox, Ren & Yu (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8173737) — not reproduced (no significant improvement over baselines found). Independently code-verified by us: src/gmixup.py prepare_dataset_x() (def at line 32) computes mean/std of node-degree features over the FULL dataset (train+val+test, post-augmentation concat at line 237) at line 49, before the train/val/test split at lines 250-253. This is a genuine data_leakage_global_preprocessing instance, confirmed by direct code reading, independent of the ReScience verdict.

title: The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: Finding Sparse, Trainable Neural Networks
issue_source: GitHub issue #15 ("The learning rate is different from the paper in iclr 2019") + independently code-verified by us: paper states (arXiv HTML, appendix table) "Optimizer Adam 1.2e-3" / "trained with Adam at a learning rate of 0.0012" for the Lenet-300-100/MNIST experiment. Code at mnist_fc/constants.py:32 sets OPTIMIZER_FN = functools.partial(tf.train.GradientDescentOptimizer, .1) — wrong optimizer (SGD not Adam) AND wrong LR (0.1 vs 0.0012).

title: Refined Coreset Selection: Towards Minimal Coreset Size under Model Performance Constraints
issue_source: Sourced from PaperBench's (arXiv 2504.01848) official ICML 2024 paper list (not ReScience/ad-hoc search). Independently code-verified by us: paper claims 20-repeat mean+/-std reporting (Table 1/2); code (run_cifar.py, run_svhn.py, run_fashion.py) hardcodes one fixed seed each with no --seed CLI flag and no repeat/aggregation mechanism anywhere in the repo.

title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Not a real paper
issue_source: Constructed by us, not found in the wild. Originally planted 4 bugs (single_seed_reporting, metric_misimplementation, test_set_contamination, eval_on_train) after research passes found zero citable real-world examples for any of them. single_seed_reporting was later retired and the code fixed once real instances were found by hand in lbcs and sample_specific_masks (both sourced from PaperBench's paper list). Now covers the 3 modes (metric_misimplementation, test_set_contamination, eval_on_train) that still have no real-world instance in this eval set.
